Reconstructing the finite multinomial sum yields all six formulas. The positive-coefficient differences in s=n-6,r=q-3 exclude d>=3; comparison d=1 versus d=2 gives unique optimal separation 2 at q=3 and 1 at q>=4. The maximal intersection plus one is necessary and sufficient for source identification from distinct exact-weight-three reads; repetition does not help. Independently recomputed multinomial sums and strict optimizer for n=6..12,q=3..8. Infinite quantifiers rest on symbolic positivity, not the finite check.
